text:
Marta: spun up quartz-mini-600 (fp32) + int8-per-channel + int6-per-channel variants on staging. did a short-query heavy smoke (6k) and also trialed a cheap cross-encoder reranker on top-50 to see if we can recover short-query hits.
Ben: interesting. which index and top-level numbers?
Ravi: paste from the smoke run artifacts:
```
model                      r@1     r@5     r@10   p95_ms
quartz-mini-600-fp32       0.627   0.803   0.858  27.1
quartz-mini-600-int8pc     0.608   0.790   0.845  16.4
quartz-mini-600-int6pc     0.578   0.765   0.820  11.2
quartz-mini-600-int8pc+rerank 0.620 0.801 0.856  38.7  # rerank cost adds latency but recovers r@1
index: faiss IVF8192,PQ64+OPQ, fallback hnsw for small vectors; metric=cosine
```
Marta: short-bucket breakdown (<6 tokens):
```
short: fp32=0.59 int8pc=0.48 int6pc=0.40 int8pc+rerank=0.56
med:   fp32=0.65 int8pc=0.64 int6pc=0.61
long:  fp32=0.71 int8pc=0.69 int6pc=0.68
```
Ben: ok int6 is pretty lossy on short queries. reranker brings most back but doubles p95. what's reranker model and budget?
Ravi: reranker is tiny-cross-encoder-90M (distil-like) run on CPU with batch size 32, only applied to short queries and top-50 candidates; avg extra latency for short queries ~11-12ms. kept as optional step in pipeline.
Marta: good approach. can we try a hybrid where short queries use int8pc+rerank and long queries use int6pc? sim the cost vs quality?
Ben: also curious whether the problem is tiny vector norm or PQ distortion. did you try L2 norm + OPQ + whitening?
Ravi: yes: we ran control experiments:
- OPQ on faiss + whitening reg=0.01 improved fp32 slightly and shrank int8 gap by ~0.015 on short queries.
- L2-normalize-before-indexing always on.
- per-channel quant configs: int8pc symmetric clamp=0.03; int6pc asymmetric outlier_clip=0.015, scale_sample=top1k. seed=2024.
Marta: did you add some top-10 failure pairs to the run artifacts? want to inspect semantic vs lexical misses.
Ravi: uploaded examples to run artifact. e.g., query "TN-42" expected product page; int6 matched mailing list; int8 matched changelog; reranker recovered product in ~60% of these.
rerank-bot: rerank-run summary: applied rerank to 5k short queries; recovered mean of 0.07 r@1 for those where embedding-to-candidates contained the true doc in top-50.
Ben: so reranker is effective when the candidate set contains the true result. we should measure candidate recall@50 as a metric too.
Ravi: candidate recall@50: fp32=0.92, int8pc=0.88, int6pc=0.78. so int6 loses many true hits before rerank can fix them.
Marta: actionable: 1) Recommend int8-per-channel for production with short-query rerank fallback if candidate_recall@50 < 0.9 for short bucket. 2) For int6 consider hybrid routing: long queries -> int6, short queries -> int8+rerank. 3) Add candidate_recall@k metrics to onboarding and Optimize alerting.
Ben: agree. also include an ef/IVF sweep to trade latency vs candidate recall. run with IVF8192->IVF16384 and PQ64->PQ128 to see candidate lift.
Ravi: ran a quick IVF increase: IVF16384+PQ128 bumped candidate_recall@50 for int6 from 0.78 -> 0.84 but p95 up ~6ms. attaching tradeoff table in artifacts.
Marta: please include exact CLI commands and run names in artifacts for reproducibility.
Ravi: commands I used:
```
python -m eval.run_embed_smoke --model quartz-mini-600 --quant none --index faiss --ivf 8192 --pq 64 --opq --seed 3 --out run_2855556789_fp32.json
python -m eval.run_embed_smoke --model quartz-mini-600 --quant int8-per-channel --clamp 0.03 --index faiss --ivf 8192 --pq 64 --opq --seed 3 --out run_2855556789_int8pc.json
python -m eval.run_embed_smoke --model quartz-mini-600 --quant int6-per-channel --out run_2855556789_int6pc.json
python -m eval.run_embed_smoke --model quartz-mini-600 --quant int8-per-channel --ivf 16384 --pq 128 --opq --out run_2855556789_ivf16384_pq128.json
```
eval-bot: automated-eval uploaded -> https://internal/redwood/runs/2855556789 (artifacts: per-cohort recall, candidate_recall@k, UMAPs, failure pairs, rerank logs) :white_check_mark:
Ben: next steps: 1) Marta to draft onboarding recommendation: default int8pc + candidate_recall@50 >= 0.9 policy, 2) Ravi to run hybrid routing sim (short->int8+rerank, long->int6) and surface cost delta, 3) add candidate_recall@50 to Optimize with regression threshold 0.03 absolute for short bucket.
Marta: adding tasks to onboarding ticket. leaving this thread open until hybrid sim and doc update complete.
Ravi: will upload hybrid sim numbers in ~2h.
